title: Counters Beginner - 2 Weeks
description: Fundamental defensive responses to Jab-Cross and Jab-Hook attacks. Learn the first 8 essential counters for each series.

days.notes: COUNTERS 1-4 (Jab-Cross): Shoulder Roll, Pari Nan Tek, Inside Wedge, Low Line Hit. Practice proper timing and structure.
COUNTERS 5-8 (Jab-Cross): Internal/External High Line Hits, Biu Ji entries. Focus on non-telegraphed ripostes.
COUNTERS 1-8 (Jab-Cross): Integration. Flow smoothly between different defensive responses.
Rest day. Mental review of the Jab-Cross counters.
COUNTERS 1-4 (Jab-Hook): Cover Coude, Inside Wedge, Insinida, Bob Wave. Focus on closing the gap safely.
COUNTERS 5-8 (Jab-Hook): Shoulder Stops, White Cover, Panatukan, Silat. Advanced defensive structures.
COUNTERS 1-8 (Jab-Hook): Integration. Maintain balance during lateral and forward entries.
Week 1 complete! Review both series mentally.
Increased volume. Focus on precision and intercepting at the right moment.
Increased volume. Ensure you are moving 'through' the opponent, not just reacting.
Combined series. Practice responding to both Cross and Hook attacks.
Endurance day. High repetitions of all 16 counters.
Speed training. Respond as quickly as possible to imaginary attacks.
Graduation Day. You've mastered the foundational counters for JKD!
